mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT strategyId, strategyName, strategyType, strategyDesc, tableShowFlag FROM (SELECT A.STRATEGY_ID strategyId, A.STRATEGY_NAME strategyName, A.STRATEGY_TYPE strategyType, A.STRATEGY_DESC strategyDesc, CASE WHEN B.EVAL_INDEX IS NOT NULL THEN '01' ELSE '02' END tableShowFlag FROM PTL_INV_STRATEGY A LEFT JOIN ptl_Strategy_Eval_Index B ON A.STRATEGY_ID = B.STRATEGY_ID WHERE A.STRATEGY_ID = #{strategyId} )

select DISTINCT T1.PTL_STGY_ID ptlStgyId,/**组合策略代码**/ T1.PORTFOLIO_ID portfolioId,/**组合代码**/ T4.PORTFOLIO_NAME portfolioName,/**组合名称**/ T3.STRATEGY_TYPE strategyType,/**策略类型**/ T1.STRATEGY_ID strategyId,/**策略代码**/ T3.STRATEGY_NAME strategyName,/**策略名称**/ T3.STRATEGY_DESC strategyDesc,/**策略描述**/ to_char(T1.EFF_DATE,'yyyy-mm-dd') effDate/**策略生效日**/
from PTL_PORTFOLIO_STGY T1/**组合策略**/ left join PTL_PORTFOLIO_EVAL T2/**组合策略指标**/ on T2.PTL_STGY_ID = T1.PTL_STGY_ID left join PTL_INV_STRATEGY T3 /**投资策略**/ on T3.STRATEGY_ID = T1.STRATEGY_ID left join PTL_PORTFOLIO T4 /**组合**/ on T4.PORTFOLIO_ID = T1.PORTFOLIO_ID left join PTL_INCOME_INDEX T5 /**收益指标目标**/ on T5.INDEX_ID = T2.INDEX_ID
where 1=1
AND T1.PORTFOLIO_ID in
#{item}
AND (T1.STRATEGY_ID in
null) OR T1.STRATEGY_ID in (
#{item} )
AND (T3.STRATEGY_TYPE in
#{item} )
AND T1.EFF_DATE BETWEEN DATE(#{startEffDate}) AND DATE(#{endEffDate})

select rate.INT_RATE*100 intRate /**指标值**/ from MST_INT_RATE_INFO rate /**利率行情**/ where rate.EFF_DATE = ( select MAX(EFF_DATE) from MST_INT_RATE_INFO /**利率行情**/ where EFF_DATE <= DATE(#{effDate})) and rate.INT_RATE_ID = #{indexId}

SELECT A.STRATEGY_EVAL_ID, A.STRATEGY_ID, A.EVAL_INDEX, C.INCOME_TYPE, C.INCOME_TARGET, C.MAX_INCOME_TARGET, C.MIN_INCOME_TARGET, D.BASE_RULE_ID, D.COEFFICIENT, D.SPREAD_RATE FROM ptl_Strategy_Eval_Index A LEFT JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO_EVAL B ON A.STRATEGY_ID = B.PTL_STGY_ID LEFT JOIN PTL_INCOME_INDEX C ON B.INDEX_ID = C.INDEX_ID LEFT JOIN PTL_INCOME_INDEX_FLOAT D ON C.INDEX_ID = D.INDEX_ID WHERE STRATEGY_ID = #{indexId}
select PORTFOLIO_NAME from PTL_PORTFOLIO where PORTFOLIO_ID = #{portfolioId}

select T1.PTL_STGY_ID ptlStgyId,/**组合策略代码**/ T1.PORTFOLIO_ID portfolioId,/**组合代码**/ T4.PORTFOLIO_NAME portfolioName,/**组合名称**/ T3.STRATEGY_TYPE strategyType,/**策略类型**/ T1.STRATEGY_ID strategyId,/**策略代码**/ T3.STRATEGY_NAME strategyName,/**策略名称**/ T3.STRATEGY_DESC strategyDesc,/**策略描述**/ to_char(T1.EFF_DATE,'yyyy-mm-dd') effDate,/**策略生效日**/ T2.INDEX_ID indexId, /**指标代码**/ T5.INCOME_TYPE incomeType,/**收益目标类型**/ T5.INCOME_TARGET*100 incomeTarget,/**收益目标**/ T5.MAX_INCOME_TARGET*100 maxIncomeTarget,/**最高收益目标**/ T5.MIN_INCOME_TARGET*100 minIncomeTarget /**最低收益目标**/ ,t2.EVAL_INDEX, CASE WHEN t2.EVAL_INDEX IS NOT NULL THEN '01' ELSE '02' END tableShowFlag from PTL_PORTFOLIO_STGY T1/**组合策略**/ left join PTL_PORTFOLIO_EVAL T2/**组合策略指标**/ on T2.PTL_STGY_ID = T1.PTL_STGY_ID left join PTL_INV_STRATEGY T3 /**投资策略**/ on T3.STRATEGY_ID = T1.STRATEGY_ID left join PTL_PORTFOLIO T4 /**组合**/ on T4.PORTFOLIO_ID = T1.PORTFOLIO_ID left join PTL_INCOME_INDEX T5 /**收益指标目标**/ on T5.INDEX_ID = T2.INDEX_ID where 1=1
AND T1.PTL_STGY_ID = #{ptlStgyId}
select BASE_RULE_ID baseRuleId, COEFFICIENT coefficient, SPREAD_RATE spreadRate from PTL_INCOME_INDEX_FLOAT where INDEX_ID = #{indexId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
